headline: Anthropic supera los 2 billones de dólares en valor de mercado en su debut en el Nasdaq
summary: Anthropic reached a market value of $2 trillion after its shares rose in their Nasdaq debut on Thursday. Investor interest in a stake in the first frontier AI company listed on a stock exchange drove the gain.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco-based AI developer behind the Claude model. Its listing is a major test of public-market appetite for frontier AI companies.
why_moved: Shares climbed in the debut on investor demand for a stake in a leading AI developer, which lifted the valuation to $2 trillion.
